thesis: ASO is in a confirmed uptrend after the 2026-11-04 breakout to a 69.62 52-week high, with cheap absolute multiples (forward P/E 9.5) and positive free cash flow, but it is stretched (RSI14 74, 11.8% above SMA20, volume fading to 0.90x). At the 65.0 mid-zone entry, reward/risk to the 72.1 target versus the ATR-capped 58.8 stop is only about 1.15, below the 1.5 minimum for Buy, in a high-confidence risk-off regime. The news and SEC filings feeds were blocked this run, so offering, litigation and event risk are unassessed; that missing data argues against opening a position.
invalidation: A daily close below 58.28 (10-day swing low) or a close back under SMA20 (about 60.2) after a failed retest of 69.62 ends the uptrend case.
